description: Liège - Shop&Drive et Kiss&Ride, adresses et disponibilité en temps réel is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Shop & Drive est une offre de stationnement gratuit (maximum 30 minutes). Ce jeu de données reprend les adresses des parkings Shop & Drive. Les informations sont régulièrement vérifiées par nos services sur le terrain. Cependant, il est possible qu'un décalage existe entre le moment de collecte des. Coverage: Liège. The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Urbanisme, Patrimoine. Its keywords are parking, shopping, shop, drive, voiture, stationnement. The portal shows 468 records. The most recent modification among them is 2022-11-14 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
